# heist_scope_rule (Resource)

A workspace URL scope rule. `ALLOW` rules expand URL scope and `BLOCK` rules take precedence over them. Rules cannot be edited, so changing any argument replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "heist_scope_rule" "block_admin" {
  pattern = "app.example.com/admin/**"
  action  = "BLOCK"
}

resource "heist_scope_rule" "allow_api" {
  pattern = "api.example.com/**"
  action  = "ALLOW"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `ALLOW` or `BLOCK`.
- `pattern` (String) Glob matched against the URL host (including port) and path, for example `example.com/private/**` or `*.example.com/**`. Omit the scheme, query string and fragment.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created.
- `id` (String) Scope rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import heist_scope_rule.block_admin 8a1d2c3b-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
```
